name: 35068 · Fultondale, AL
findings: ZIP 35068 (Fultondale) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35068 (Fultondale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
